verdict: Permuting within intermediary alone does not preserve the rural association with year or project type, so its p-value is a sensitivity under an assumption of exchangeability conditional on intermediary. Restricting permutations to exact intermediary-by-year-by-type strata preserves every conditioned margin and is the stricter test, at the cost of resting on the 34% of projects that sit in mixed strata. Neither test rejects the null.
